title: neoboutonia melleri
intro:
Neoboutonia melleri, commonly known as the African milkwood, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant is known for its health benefits, including its use in traditional medicine to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Neoboutonia melleri include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
